svg.text: McCzarny recently enhanced his ghsummary and
chromium-daily-digest projects. In ghsummary,
he updated the LLM models to gemini-3.6-flash
and gemini-3.5-flash-lite. He also introduced
basic Markdown formatting support for SVG
summaries, rendering bold, italic, and inline
code. For chromium-daily-digest, he updated its
Gemini AI service to use gemini-3.6-flash and
gemini-3.5-flash-lite models. He improved
logging in chromium-daily-digest to provide
clearer rate limit warnings for specific
services. A missing favicon was added to the
chromium-daily-digest project. He implemented
dynamic logic to change the favicon and main
logo on the Chromium Daily Digest page,
indicating new content. In his
McCzarny/McCzarny repository, he added a
GITHUB_TOKEN to the generate-summary workflow.
He also updated this workflow to use the master
branch of the ghsummary action, ensuring the
latest stable version.
